step-1.text: Build it in the room it will live in. Stand the headboard where the bed will go, a hand-width from the wall.

step-2.text: Hold a side rail against the headboard and bolt it on, two bolts. Then the other rail. Keep the ledge grooves facing in.

count-2.text: This step uses 2 side rails and 4 bolts.

step-3.text: Bring in the footboard and bolt both rails to it. Leave the bolts a little loose until the frame is square.

count-3.text: This step uses 1 footboard and 4 bolts.

step-4.text: Measure corner to corner both ways. When the two diagonals match, the frame is square. Now tighten every bolt.

count-4.text: Nothing new this step. Just you and the frame.

step-5.text: Screw a slat ledge along the inside of each rail, flush with the bottom of the groove.

count-5.text: This step uses 2 slat ledges and 16 screws.

step-6.text: Hang the center beam between the headboard and the footboard, then twist its support leg down until it touches the floor. The middle needs support too.

count-6.text: This step uses 1 center beam and 4 screws.

step-7.text: Unroll the slats across the ledges, curved side up, and space them evenly. Seventeen slats, clipped or screwed at the ends.

done.text: Done. Your TARVA bed frame, queen is built. Give it a proud little pat.
